highest_priority_permission_question: Do the opt-in checkbox and the IN.gov personal-use limit allow a third party to copy names, business names, and telephone numbers from the guide table into a commercial directory, and does the license or that listing authorize a directory claim? The sources checked on 2026-11-25 do not answer it.
